en.text: Deliver me, LORD, from evil men.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你拯救我脱离凶恶的人，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你拯救我脫離凶惡的人，

en.text: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.
They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. is under their lips.
LORD, keep me from the hands of the wicked. me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你拯救我脱离恶人的手，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你拯救我脫離惡人的手，

en.text: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me.

zhSimplified.text: 骄傲人为我暗设网罗和绳索；

zhTraditional.text: 驕傲人為我暗設網羅和繩索；

en.text: I said to the LORD, “You are my God.” to the cry of my petitions, LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 我曾对耶和华说：你是我的 神。

zhTraditional.text: 我曾對耶和華說：你是我的上帝。

en.text: LORD, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.

zhSimplified.text: 主—耶和华、我救恩的力量啊，

zhTraditional.text: 主－耶和華、我救恩的力量啊，

en.text: LORD, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你不要遂恶人的心愿； 他们自高。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你不要遂惡人的心願； 他們自高。

en.text: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

zhSimplified.text: 至于那些昂首围困我的人， 自己！

zhTraditional.text: 至於那些昂首圍困我的人， 自己！

en.text: Let burning coals fall on them. be thrown into the fire, from where they never rise.
An evil speaker won’t be established on the earth. will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

zhSimplified.text: 说恶言的人在地上必坚立不住；

zhTraditional.text: 說惡言的人在地上必堅立不住；

en.text: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.

zhSimplified.text: 我知道耶和华必为困苦人伸冤，

zhTraditional.text: 我知道耶和華必為困苦人伸冤，

en.text: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
